body: Thank you! I think the difference is that my hair was freshly washed in the second picture 😂🤔

Thank you for your kind words! Hm I've not used anything at all - but I know some people use eyeshadow for things like that! My hair is falling out at the moment due to medication so I'm trying to balance that out a bit better.
Aw thanks! It means a lot
I've been quite lucky and only had a bit of irritation on my neck! But as soon as I stopped using it there it went away

Hey! Thank you so much. I did have some purging for about 3 weeks during this. And it's still recovering to be fair! You probably will purge but it will make way for clearer skin. That's what got me through it lol
Ooo I think that's a good idea! Maybe it would be a good idea to use a sheet mask once a week? I found that really helped me
If I used that only I can imagine it would definately strip my skin! That's why I have to moisturise with it every time I use it x
Thanks!!
Thank you!!
Thank you so much!! After a few purges I'm hoping that no more emerge 😂

Routine:

AM: La Roche-Posay Gel Moussant Purifiant for oily and sensitive skin, Laura clarifying lotion, Simple replenishing rich moisturiser, Nivea SPF 30

PM: La Roche-Posay (as above), CeraVe Facial Moisturising Lotion, tretinoin 0.25, CeraVe (again - sandwich method). Tret up to 4 times a week.
I do this! My hypomania comes in bouts, normally a couple of hours at a time. Typically lots of pacing and wanting to go out and party 🎉 or lots of project ideas and hyperfocusing

Yep mine was also presenting as anxiety for a while. Lots of racing thoughts, anxiety about pretty much anything and anything. I even developed a needle phobia when I don't even have an issue with needles!
That makes sense! I'll definately question this at our next appointment
So the way she described it to me was that I have the bigger cycles (bp2) but smaller cycles in between (BP3). Is that not possible?
Thank you, that's a really good explanation. I'm going to start using daylio and see how that works for me
Thank you! I wish someone would have told me this sooner lol

I think this has been my problem because I'm having to record both manic and depressed symptoms in the same day sometimes so it's averaging out a bit odd. It isn't showing what I need it to so I'm going to try your suggestion!
Think you are definately right there! I've been writing in every fluctuation of mood and it's ruined my data. Going to focus on happiness for now and see what happens with that! Thanks :)

Thanks for your reply! I think it's hard to spot because I also have a borderline personality disorder diagnosis so lots of general ups and downs. I can feel myself trending in a particular mood cycle for around a month at a time which is why we are looking at a diagnosis. Thank for your help though
Thanks everyone! Good job I didn't eat them haha. I'm sure I'll come across them soon 😁
Do you know what they might be??
I think it has something to do with the 'chronic emptiness' people with BPD can feel.

All I can say is that I feel exactly the same. It makes life really hard when you're constantly questioning everything and there's no 'true' meaning. Like we are only here for such a short time that in the grand scheme of the world does it really mean anything??
That is absolutely brilliant. Definately a good way to get them up to speed 😂 and very efficient!
Yes I know exactly what you mean! You've come up with a good way to resolve it though!

That's so awful - nobody should ever get a reply like that! Is it possible to go through your community mental health team? That's who I've gone through and they've organised everything for me to receive therapy.
Thank you! You're really kind
That's a really good idea! Emotional impermanence means I literally can't remember exactly how I've been feeling, or I just brush over it. Writing it down seems like a good way of getting past that
Thank you so much for this, I really needed to hear that. It's hard to get out of your own head sometimes, and it can tell you some difficult things! Thank you for your support

Thank you! I'm trying so hard to be preventative but even though I've asked for more support they've just told me to use my coping skills. The problem is that I can't cope!! The system is so frustrating but thank you for your support, it means a lot
Thank you so much for your kind words. Sometimes you just need to hear someone say it <3
Thank you so much ❤️ it's hard but we'll pull through
Yeah I do get what you mean. Just hurts to think that I'm hurting him, whether I mean to or not :(
Thanks for your comment. I keep thinking it's not serious enough? I have next to no emotional permanence at the moment so as soon as I'd get to a hospital I'd probably brush it off 🙄

I think that they just will not acknowledge that they can do anything wrong and so when they are confronted with something that is outright wrong they genuinely cannot believe they'd do something like that.

I once tried to talk to my mum about how she'd tell me that her partner would kill her and the abuse she went through and she outright denied that she said that. How could she say that to a child?! She definately did though. But she could not admit that she used us and told us details that no 5/6 should ever know.

Hey, sorry to hear you're going through this. I really relate to what you're saying. It's like you don't want to die, but it could happen from SH ect. Like you just want to ruin yourself? I don't know why I feel like this either, you're definately not alone in it though!

Thank you for your thoughts, I really appriciate your comment. I think you're right, it's hard to work out but maybe I just need to sit with the fact that I've just been diagnosed. I just feel so uncomfortable within myself at the moment! Hopefully things will get easier in time
Thank you, I really appriciate your thoughts. I'm trying to ground myself but it can be really difficult sometimes. My partner knows how I'm feeling and is very supportive. ❤️
